verses.en: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
verses.pt: E eu disse: Ouvi agora, vós líderes de Jacó, e governantes da casa de Israel; por acaso não é vossa responsabilidade saber o que é justo?
verses.en_web: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
verses.en_bbe: And I said, Give ear, now, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the people of Israel: is it not for you to have knowledge of what is right?

verses.en: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.pt: Vós odiais o bem e amais o mal; vós roubais a pele dos outros, e a carne de seus ossos;
verses.en_web: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.en_bbe: You who are haters of good and lovers of evil, pulling off their skin from them and their flesh from their bones;

verses.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.pt: Vós sois os que comeis a carne de meu povo, e lhes tirais sua pele, e lhes quebrais seus ossos; e os despedaçais como para a panela, como carne dentro do caldeirão.
verses.en_web: who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
verses.en_bbe: Like meat they take the flesh of my people for their food, skinning them and crushing their bones, yes, cutting them up as if for the pot, like flesh inside the cooking-pot.

verses.en: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
verses.pt: Então clamareis ao SENHOR, mas ele não vos responderá; ao invés disso esconderá sua face diante de vós naquele tempo, pois praticastes maus atos.
verses.en_web: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
verses.en_bbe: Then they will be crying to the Lord for help, but he will not give them an answer: yes, he will keep his face veiled from them at that time, because their acts have been evil.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR contra os profetas que fazem o meu povo errar, que quando recebem comida proclamam paz, mas declaram guerra contra quem não lhes dá de comer;
verses.en_web: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said about the prophets by whom my people have been turned from the right way; who, biting with their teeth, say, Peace; and if anyone puts nothing in their mouths they make ready for war against him.

verses.en: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
verses.pt: Portanto se vos fará noite por causa da profecia, e trevas por causa da adivinhação; e o sol se porá sobre estes profetas, e o dia se escurecerá sobre eles.
verses.en_web: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause it will be night for you, without a vision; and it will be dark for you, without knowledge of the future; the sun will go down over the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

verses.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
verses.pt: E os videntes se envergonharão, e os adivinhos serão humilhados; todos cobrirão o lábio, porque não haverá resposta de Deus.
verses.en_web: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer from God.”
verses.en_bbe: And the seers will be shamed, and the readers of the future will be at a loss, all of them covering their lips; for there is no answer from God.

verses.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.pt: Porém eu estou cheio do poder do Espírito do SENHOR, e de juízo, e de força, para anunciar a Jacó sua transgressão, e a Israel seu pecado.
verses.en_web: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
verses.en_bbe: But I truly am full of the spirit of the Lord, with power of judging and with strength to make clear to Jacob his wrongdoing and to Israel his sin.

verses.en: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
verses.pt: Ouvi agora isto, vós líderes da casa de Jacó, e governantes da casa de Israel, que abominais a justiça, e perverteis tudo o que é justo;
verses.en_web: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity.
verses.en_bbe: Then give ear to this, you heads of the children of Jacob, you rulers of the children of Israel, hating what is right, twisting what is straight.

verses.en: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.pt: Vós edificais a Sião com sangue, e a Jerusalém com injustiça;
verses.en_web: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: They are building up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with evil-doing.

verses.en: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
verses.pt: Seus líderes julgam por suborno, seus sacerdotes ensinam por salário, e seus profetas adivinham por dinheiro; e se apoiam no SENHOR dizendo: Por acaso o SENHOR não está entre nós? Nenhum mal virá sobre nós.
verses.en_web: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh among us? No disaster will come on us.”
verses.en_bbe: Its heads take rewards for judging, and the priests take payment for teaching, and the prophets get silver for reading the future: but still, supporting themselves on the Lord, they say, Is not the Lord among us? no evil will overtake us.

verses.en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
verses.pt: Portanto por causa de vós Sião será arada como campo, e Jerusalém se tornará um amontoado de pedras, e o monte do templo como os lugares altos de um bosque.
verses.en_web: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, Zion will be ploughed like a field because of you, and Jerusalem will become a mass of broken walls, and the mountain of the house like a high place in the woods.
